parsed.explanation: Under the parent regime, the visitor faces universal-exposure exposures: foreign passports with nonbinary or non-matching markers may be blocked or confiscated at processing, visa officers are instructed to refuse cases with document discrepancies and to consider lifetime fraud findings, entry screening risks outing, and the national posture is overtly hostile though partly enjoined in court. This division adds a broad birth-sex facility rule for all schools and colleges (public and private) but with no enforcement mechanism and no documented arrests, sits second-highest rather than top in the 2026 risk tiering, and retains partial mitigations (33 municipal anti-discrimination ordinances, an employment executive order, functioning marker-change routes though narrowing). No documented targeting of visitors, no criminal facility offence here. That places it at the elevated-risk boundary: universal national document exposure plus an unremedied institutional facility restriction, partially offset by local protections and absent criminalisation — comparable to the 0.45 anchors, not materially below them.
